assignments.title: Linked List Operations
assignments.brief: Implement a singly linked list supporting append, insert-after, delete-after and reversal. Provide the operations for a doubly linked list as a separate implementation and comment on the memory and asymptotic trade-off between the two.

rubric.description: All required operations implemented and correct on non-trivial inputs.
Time and space cost stated for every operation, with justification.
Readable code, clear naming, and the requested trade-off discussion.

assignments.title: Binary Search Tree Implementation
assignments.brief: Implement a binary search tree with insertion, search, minimum, in-order traversal and the full three-case deletion. Include a test set that demonstrates what happens when keys are inserted in sorted order, and relate the observed behaviour to the tree's height.

rubric.description: Insertion, search, minimum, traversal and all three deletion cases correct.
Test set covers sorted insertion and the degenerate-height case.
Complexity claims stated and justified per operation.

assignments.title: Graph Shortest Paths
assignments.brief: Given a weighted directed graph, compute single-source shortest paths. Implement Dijkstra's algorithm and show why it fails when a negative edge is present. Contrast the result with a breadth-first search on the unweighted version of the same graph.

rubric.description: Dijkstra correct on all non-negative instances; failure on the negative instance correctly explained.
Complexity stated for Dijkstra and for the BFS contrast.
Clear written report tying implementation to the cut-property justification.
